faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started.
faq.a1: Classes are conducted live via video call using our integrated platform. You'll meet your teacher face-to-face and interact in real time, just like an in-person class — from the comfort of your home.
faq.q2: Can parents monitor their child's progress?
faq.a2: Yes! Our dedicated parent portal gives you full visibility into your child's attendance, recitation progress, teacher notes, and upcoming sessions.
faq.q3: What age groups do you teach?
faq.a3: We teach students of all ages, from children as young as 5 years old to adults. We have specialized teachers for each age group to ensure the most effective learning experience.
faq.q4: How are teachers selected and verified?
faq.a4: All our teachers hold certifications from recognized Islamic institutions such as Al-Azhar University. They undergo rigorous background checks and teaching assessments before joining.
faq.q5: Can I try a class before subscribing?
faq.a5: Absolutely! We offer a free trial session so you can meet your teacher and experience our platform before committing to any plan.
faq.q6: What if I need to reschedule a session?
faq.a6: You can easily reschedule sessions up to 12 hours in advance through your student dashboard, with no penalty.
